visual_evidence: All seven original north-up context sheets and all seven marked native detail sheets were examined, comparing the water-facing contact against the interior beach and buildings.
decision: The 38 marked positions follow the visible water-facing contact. Two contacts are obscured by shadow beside shore structures and the last axis crosses the pier. Do not retain the old landward positions as established 2011 references.
tolerance_note: Interpretation was made against the visible contact at native pixel scale; the 8 m operational proxy is not a permissible dry-sand margin or a certified physical error.
